book.name: Roma
book.title: Paulas ke tjietthie Roma ke iesaai log khaatien

content: Paulas sab ke jaad kare hai
Ham aapan iesaai bahien Febe ke toelogke oeppar saupiela. Oe Kenkrejen sahar ke samaadj me Prabhoe khaatien kaam kare hai.

Oke Prabhoe ke naam se apane bietj me leihe djaise bieswaasie log ke tjaahie kare ke. Oe dher manai log ke aur hamke bhie sahaaita karies hai. Ohie se djab oke koetjh djaroerie rahie tab oke barhia se sewa kariehe.
Ham Préska aur Aakwéla ke jaad kariela. Hamlog tieno mielke Kriest Jiesoe khaat kaam karat rahielie.
Oelog hamaar khaatien aapan djaan par khelies raha. Na khaalie ham, bakie doesar djaat ke iesaai ke samaadj logan bhie oelogke dhanbaad dewe hai.
Ham oelogke ghare aawe waala samaadj logan ke bhie jaad kariela, aur bhie aapan pjaara iesaai bhaai Epénetas ke. Oe Aasia des ke pahiela aadmie raha djaun Kriest me bieswaas kare lagal.
Aur ham bhie Maria ke jaad kariela. Oe toelog khaatien bahoet kausies karies hai.

Ham Andróniekas aur Jóenias ke bhie jaad kariela. Oe doeno hamaar koel me ke hai. Oelog bhie hamaar sanghe djahal me raha aur pathaawal waalan ghat barka maanal dja hai. Oesab hamse pahiele Kriest me saamiel bhail hai.
Ham aapan pjaara bhaai Ampliáatas ke jaad kariela. Ham Prabhoe ke dwaara ose ek baatie.
Ham Oerbáanas ke jaad kariela. Oe Kriest ke kaam me hamlogke sanghe hai. Aur ham pjaara Stáakes ke jaad kariela, aur
bhie Aapéles ke. Oe safa se dekhaais hai kie oe Kriest par bharosa kare hai. Aur ham bhie Arestobóelas ke samaadj waalan ke jaad kariela.
Ham Heródion ke jaad kariela. Hamlog ekahie koel me ke baatie. Aur ham bhie Narsésas ke samaadj log ke jaad kariela.
Ham Trieféna aur Triefósa ke jaad kariela. Ie doei aurat Prabhoe khaatien kaam karies hai. Aur ham bhie aapan pjaara Perses ke jaad kariela. Oe Prabhoe ke kaam me bahoet haath lagaais hai.
Ham aapan bhaai Róefoes ke jaad kariela. Oe Prabhoe ke aakhie me ek barhia aadmie hai. Aur ham bhie okar maai ke jaad kariela. Oe djaise hamaar maai hai.
Ham Aasénkrietas ke jaad kariela, aur bhie Flégon, Hérmes, Páatrobas, Hérmas aur hoewa ke ekwan iesaai bhaai-bahien log ke.
Ham Fielólogas, Jóelia, Néras aur okar bahien ke bhie jaad kariela. Aur Olémpas aur hoewa ke sab bieswaasie log ke bhie.
Djab toelog ek iesaai ke bhaai-bahien ke bhetaihe, tab oke gale lagiehe. Hia ke sab Kriest ke samaadj log toelogke jaad kare hai.
Batjaaike rahoe

Bhaai-bahien logan, ek tjiedj auro hai. Samaadj me koetjh manai log djhagara lagwaawe hai aur doesare ke Jiesoe ke rasta par se bhatkaawe hai. Toelog aise na siekhle hai. Ohie se oe manai se doer rahiehe.

Oesab Prabhoe Kriest khaatien kaam na kare hai, bakie apane khaatien. Oelog khaalie maange hai aapan laalietj poera kare. Oelog aapan bhaktie aur barhia baat se bhola-bhaala manai log ke bahakaawe hai.

Sab koi to djaan gail hai kie toelog kaise Kriest ke baat par dhiaan lagaawe hai. Ohie se ham bahoet khoesie baatie. Ham maangiela kie toelog na khaalie djaan dja kaun tjiedj barhia hai, bakie bhie kie toelog kharaabie se doer rahoe.
Parmeswar me se sab sjaantie oetpan howe hai. Oe haalie se saitaan ke toelogke gor ke tare katjarwaai deiga. Ham praatna kariela kie Prabhoe Jiesoe toelogke bhalaai kare.
Jaad kare waalan
Hamaar saamiel waala Tiemotias aur hamaar koel waalan Lóesias, Jáason aur Sosíepaatar toelogke jaad kare hai.
Tersioes hamaar khaat ie tjietthie ke baat liekhe hai aur oe toelogke bhie jaad kare hai. Oe hamlogke bieswaasie ke bhaai hai.
Ham Gaajas ke hia rahiela. Oe aur okar ghare ke samaadj logan toelogke bhie jaad kare hai. Ie sahar moenieraam Eráastas, aur bhaai Kwaartas toelogke bhie jaad kare hai. [
Hamlogke Prabhoe Jiesoe Kriest toeloganke bhalaai kare. Aisahie to hai.]
Parmeswar ke maahaan maanie dja!
Parmeswar toelogke bieswaas barhaai sake hai aur ham ie khoes khabar Jiesoe Kriest ke biese me ailaan kariela. Oe bariesan se ie koi ke na djanaais raha,

bakie ab ie baat sagaro bataawal dja hai. Parmeswar sab djoeg ke hai, aur oe hoekoem deis hai doenia bhar ke djaatie logan ke aapan liekhal baat djanaawe ke, djeme oesab okar baat soenke bieswaas kare.
Khaalie oke sab gjaan hai, aur oe Jiesoe Kriest dwaara bahoet barka kaam karies hai! Ohie se aaw hamlog sada ke lieje oke maahaan maanie dja! Ha, aisahie to hai.
